subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which canonical path should own the remaining #93383 work: land/refresh the focused open PRs, replace them with one maintainer-owned session/delivery fix, or split Telegram typing into a separate canonical issue?
rationale: Current main only partially fixes the issue, while open PRs #89039 and #91797 and issue #97021 overlap across session-state, message delivery, and channel typing boundaries that ClawSweeper should not resolve with another competing automated PR.

options.title: Keep #93383 as umbrella and sequence focused PRs
options.body: Use #93383 to coordinate the retained-lock, no-op fence, silent-delivery, and typing slices while maintaining narrow PR ownership for each behavior.

options.title: Replace with one maintainer-owned repair
options.body: Pause overlapping contributor PRs and land one cohesive session/delivery fix if maintainers want a single ownership boundary and proof plan.

options.title: Split Telegram typing out
options.body: Keep session/delivery fixes under #93383 and route stuck Telegram typing to #97021 if maintainers decide channel cleanup is a distinct bug.

recommendation.title: Keep #93383 as umbrella and sequence focused PRs
recommendation.body: Use #93383 to coordinate the retained-lock, no-op fence, silent-delivery, and typing slices while maintaining narrow PR ownership for each behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They verified and merged the partial fix while explicitly preserving this issue for the broader remaining behavior.
